page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs, providing a 1:1 core-to-thread ratio. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate average single-core capabilities but weaker multi-core scaling. The single-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores fall into the average tier, supported by Intel's AVX-512 instruction set extensions and cryptography acceleration via AES. However, multi-core benchmarks, such as Geekbench multi-core and stress-ng multi-core, register in the lower percentiles. Memory bandwidth tests show relatively weak performance, with uncached read speeds at 31.69 GB/sec and write speeds at 25.55 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7ne.xlarge offers a dedicated hardware profile without the overhead of shared-core resource contention, though its multi-threaded performance-per-resource ratio is modest. It is best suited for workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation but do not demand high multi-threaded throughput or massive memory bandwidth. Suitable applications include lightweight web serving, basic text processing, single-threaded utility scripts, and small-scale development or staging environments.
